compiled_state.description:
## Context
Reviewer advisory on Gerrit change 3117 (story e873, which commits .test_durations). To stop gitleaks flagging the profile, `.gitleaks.toml` gained a third targeted allowlist for the fake PEM shape that tests/unit/test_identity_ac1_401a_heldout.py parametrizes on: a BEGIN header, a body of exactly one `x`, an END line, with the newlines literal or escaped. It is scoped by content, not by path.

e873 measured the fix by hand with the review bot's own command (`gitleaks detect --no-banner --no-git --source <dir> --exit-code 0`, no --config): the profile went from 3 findings to 0, and a control file with a real-shaped PEM key (200-character random body) stayed at 1 finding. Nothing in the test suite pins that. The repo already has a harness for exactly this: `test_repo_gitleaks_config_allowlists_doc_throwaway_but_not_real_secret` in tests/unit/test_code_review_ws5.py. A later edit to the regex could silently broaden the exemption to real keys.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] A test reusing that harness asserts that the fake shape (header, one `x`, END line; both literal-newline and escaped-newline forms) yields 0 findings and that a PEM key with a long random body yields 1 (checked: the test, run with gitleaks installed).
- [ ] The test fails when the allowlist regex is widened to match any PEM body (checked: a recorded mutation run).
- [ ] `make verify` shows no failure outside the known pandoc set, and the Gerrit change is `Verified +1`.
compiled_state.title: Pin the fake-PEM gitleaks allowlist with a regression test
